name: Achilló
subtitle: Jon's Achilles rehab log
description: Private AltStore source for the Achilló rehab app. Builds are published by the app's build script.

apps.name: Achilló
apps.subtitle: Guided Achilles rehab, by ear
apps.localizedDescription: Daily post-op Achilles program: BFR, Chris's barefoot and boot-on routines, hourly quick ones, hinge ladder, imagery. Audio cues keep going with the screen locked; reminders come from the app.

versions.localizedDescription: Audio falls back automatically if the native player fails, and shows the reason. New: Settings > Diagnostics, a log of audio and session events you can share. Fixed: after picking a quick one, the screen could stop responding to taps.

Reminder times are now any time you like (iOS time wheel): morning check, evening round, imagery. Quick-one spacing from 30 min to 3 h, last one up to 11 PM. Evening round and imagery default to 8 and 9 PM.

Audio rebuilt on native iOS: cues play through the system audio player and the voice through iOS speech, so they no longer fight or stall. Headphones out pauses the session. If audio fails to start you get a Retry button. Lock-screen shows the exercise with working pause/skip. Session controls are proper circles again, and the sound buttons are back.
